extracted.intended_audience: general public, journalists, students and researchers interested in EU institutions and the European Commission's communications
extracted.subtask_short: EU DG COMM mission and role
extracted.subtask_description: Short organisational overview of the Directorate‑General for Communication (DG COMM) of the European Commission, summarising its stated mission and role within the Commission's administration. Useful for understanding the DG's communication objectives (e.g., for press offices, journalists, or civic actors interacting with EU communications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform media and citizens of Commission activities and communicate policy objectives
rubrics_metrics.description: To inform the media and citizens of the activities of the European Commission and to communicate the objectives and goals of its policies and actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated mission of DG COMM. As an evaluative desideratum for communications (including press releases), this implies content should clearly explain Commission activities and articulate the objectives/goals of policies and actions to both media and the general public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inform the Commission of the evolution of opinion in Member States
rubrics_metrics.description: To inform the Commission of the evolution of opinion in the Member States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stated mission of DG COMM. As a functional requirement, DG COMM should monitor public and media opinion across Member States and report that evolution back to the Commission; communications outputs may therefore be evaluated by how well they capture and convey public sentiment and feedback.
